Waterlogic is an innovative global designer, manufacturer, distributor and service provider of
drinking water dispensers designed for offices, schools, hospitals, hospitality and public spaces.

Behind every drop of Waterlogic water are 30 years of knowledge, innovation and experience to
deliver purified, great-tasting water in the safest and most sustainable way. Over 50 million people
in more than 70 countries enjoy superior drinking water and service that is second to none.

More about us

## Waterlogic is committed to a sustainable future


Every day we drive change through our own organisation and the communities we touch with the goal of
acting in the best interests of people and the environment. Our commitment to Environmental, Social
and Governance (ESG) aligns with our business values, purpose and strategy with the needs of all our
stakeholders, whilst embedding responsible and ethical principles into everything we do.
* [Reduce carbon emissions by 2.5%]
  
  #### Reduce carbon emissions by 2.5%
  
  2.5% annual reduction of Scope 1 and 2 carbon emissions (on-site use of liquid fuel and gas, use
  of fuel in owned vehicles, use of grid and renewable energy)
* [Reduce single-use plastic by 1 billion bottles]
  
  #### Reduce single-use plastic by 1 billion bottles
  
  1 billion annual reduction in the number of single-use plastic bottles consumed by championing
  consumer change and growing the net installation of mains-fed dispensers

#### More than 40 partners have joined our distribution network over the last 10 years and
#### successfully developed a strong and profitable business with our support

Waterlogic works with partners in over 50 countries, meaning more people in more places enjoy the
highest quality water from Waterlogic. Our distributors are not only able to offer their customers
the world’s most highly certified purification technology across a range of hydration solutions for
businesses of all sizes, but they also receive comprehensive business, technical support and
training from our experienced Waterlogic Trading team.

# Better thinking, better water, better for you, better for the planet^{TM}

drinking water dispensers designed for offices, schools, hospitals, hospitality and public spaces.

Behind every drop of Waterlogic water are 30 years of knowledge, innovation and experience to
deliver purified, great-tasting water in the safest and most sustainable way. Over 50 million people
in more than 70 countries enjoy superior drinking water and service that is second to none.

## Waterlogic is committed to a sustainable future


Every day we drive change through our own organisation and the communities we touch with the goal of
acting in the best interests of people and the environment. Our commitment to Environmental, Social
and Governance (ESG) aligns with our business values, purpose and strategy with the needs of all our
stakeholders, whilst embedding responsible and ethical principles into everything we do.

### WHO IS BRIDEN SOLUTIONS?

Welcome!
Briden Solutions is a family owned and operated business located in Calgary, Alberta. Our roots are
in emergency preparedness and our goal is to help our fellow Canadians feel the Peace of Mind that
comes from being prepared for natural disasters like floods, earthquake, tornado, wildfire, ice
storms, winter storms, etc.

Right from the beginning our main focus has been researching and sourcing great food products for
our community. We've hand curated a selection of freeze dried, dehydrated and wet pack food from the
best manufacturers in North America. Great tasting, easy to use food for all your emergency, camping
and outdoor needs. We only bring in the best!

And why should you work with us?
#1) We care – As a family owned business, we are not just here to push product out the door. We
sincerely want you to feel the Peace of Mind that can come from being prepared. We will take the
time to answer your questions. We will take the time to look at what concerns you. And we will take
the time to help create a plan that truly brings that peace of mind to your world.

#2) We are Canadians – Born and raised. We live here, and we understand and research the needs
Canadians have. We love this country, and we want to make it better by helping people.

#3) We’re involved – We don’t just talk the talk. During the Calgary flood of 2013, our team
volunteered hundreds of hours sand bagging before the flood and hundreds of hours after the flood
slugging mud out of basements. During the Fort McMurray fires of 2016 we worked with our customers
and together we donated and delivered nearly $50,000 in food to the evacuation centers and
firefighters. We teach people to prepare before a disaster strikes, but we are still going to be
here to help after it happens.

#4) We’ve been around the longest. Operating officially since 2009, along with our Sister company In
Case of, who has been here since 2002. We are the Canadian pioneers of the survival and emergency
industry. We've helped people through the Ebola pandemic, the Japan earthquake and nuclear meltdown,
the end of the world in 2012, floods that washed away towns, fires that destroyed whole cities, and
countless other storms along the way both nature and man-made.

#5) We’ve got the largest emergency food selection in Canada - We proudly carry the Nutristore,
Chef's Banquet, Peak Refuel, Mountain House, Alpine Aire, Backpackers Pantry, Datrex, Chief Mountain
Harvest, Clif Bar, GoodToGo, Made Good, Thrive Provisions, Pro Bar, Nuun, Trail Butter and
HoneyStinger lines in Canada. These food lines span all of the food groups and food types, giving
you the widest choice in your food preparations. We have food pouches, food cans, food buckets and
food boxes. Doesn't get much wider than that.

#6) We’ve tried it all – Everything on our website we’ve tested ourselves, either in our home at the
dinner table with our kids, while out camping, or on a mountain top hiking trip. Nothing gets into
our warehouse that I wouldn’t be proud to use myself. We carry the best tasting and healthiest
survival and outdoor foods, and gear that works how it should when you need it.

#7) We don’t waste your time - We don’t carry anything that doesn’t have a specific purpose within
the emergency or outdoor worlds. There is nothing on this website that you might call “filler”
products. Only food and gear that makes sense for people trying to prepare for emergencies or their
next camping trip.

#8) We are real - We have a storefront, a warehouse, employees, and a lot of stock on the ground
here in Canada. We are not just a website with affiliate links for another company. Our team packs
and ships all our products daily across Canada using all the major couriers.

I’ll stop there, but the point is the Briden team is going to do everything we can for you when you
choose to gear up with us. We will be there for you today, tomorrow, and all along the way. Give us
a call, email us or stop by the store. We are here for you.

Thanks for your time, we look forward to working with you.

Dwight & Kristen
Owners of Briden Solutions

### WHO IS BRIDEN SOLUTIONS?

Welcome!
Briden Solutions is a family owned and operated business located in Calgary, Alberta. Our roots are
in emergency preparedness and our goal is to help our fellow Canadians feel the Peace of Mind that
comes from being prepared for natural disasters like floods, earthquake, tornado, wildfire, ice
storms, winter storms, etc.

Right from the beginning our main focus has been researching and sourcing great food products for
our community. We've hand curated a selection of freeze dried, dehydrated and wet pack food from the
best manufacturers in North America. Great tasting, easy to use food for all your emergency, camping
and outdoor needs. We only bring in the best!

And why should you work with us?
#1) We care – As a family owned business, we are not just here to push product out the door. We
sincerely want you to feel the Peace of Mind that can come from being prepared. We will take the
time to answer your questions. We will take the time to look at what concerns you. And we will take
the time to help create a plan that truly brings that peace of mind to your world.

#2) We are Canadians – Born and raised. We live here, and we understand and research the needs
Canadians have. We love this country, and we want to make it better by helping people.

#3) We’re involved – We don’t just talk the talk. During the Calgary flood of 2013, our team
volunteered hundreds of hours sand bagging before the flood and hundreds of hours after the flood
slugging mud out of basements. During the Fort McMurray fires of 2016 we worked with our customers
and together we donated and delivered nearly $50,000 in food to the evacuation centers and
firefighters. We teach people to prepare before a disaster strikes, but we are still going to be
here to help after it happens.

#4) We’ve been around the longest. Operating officially since 2009, along with our Sister company In
Case of, who has been here since 2002. We are the Canadian pioneers of the survival and emergency
industry. We've helped people through the Ebola pandemic, the Japan earthquake and nuclear meltdown,
the end of the world in 2012, floods that washed away towns, fires that destroyed whole cities, and
countless other storms along the way both nature and man-made.

#5) We’ve got the largest emergency food selection in Canada - We proudly carry the Nutristore,
Chef's Banquet, Peak Refuel, Mountain House, Alpine Aire, Backpackers Pantry, Datrex, Chief Mountain
Harvest, Clif Bar, GoodToGo, Made Good, Thrive Provisions, Pro Bar, Nuun, Trail Butter and
HoneyStinger lines in Canada. These food lines span all of the food groups and food types, giving
you the widest choice in your food preparations. We have food pouches, food cans, food buckets and
food boxes. Doesn't get much wider than that.

#6) We’ve tried it all – Everything on our website we’ve tested ourselves, either in our home at the
dinner table with our kids, while out camping, or on a mountain top hiking trip. Nothing gets into
our warehouse that I wouldn’t be proud to use myself. We carry the best tasting and healthiest
survival and outdoor foods, and gear that works how it should when you need it.

#7) We don’t waste your time - We don’t carry anything that doesn’t have a specific purpose within
the emergency or outdoor worlds. There is nothing on this website that you might call “filler”
products. Only food and gear that makes sense for people trying to prepare for emergencies or their
next camping trip.

#8) We are real - We have a storefront, a warehouse, employees, and a lot of stock on the ground
here in Canada. We are not just a website with affiliate links for another company. Our team packs
and ships all our products daily across Canada using all the major couriers.

I’ll stop there, but the point is the Briden team is going to do everything we can for you when you
choose to gear up with us. We will be there for you today, tomorrow, and all along the way. Give us
a call, email us or stop by the store. We are here for you.

Thanks for your time, we look forward to working with you.

Dwight & Kristen
Owners of Briden Solutions

# 100,000 Australians

Complete Home Filtration is Australia’s pioneer in whole home water filtration. We design premium,
customisable systems tailored to your water supply, home and family. Backed by expert installation,
dedicated aftercare and nationwide support, we help protect homes and support everyday health and
wellbeing.

## Whole home water filtration Premium systems, better water from every tap

Australian water varies widely by location and water source. What works in one home may not work in
another. Complete Home Filtration systems are designed to adapt to those differences, delivering
consistently clean, great-tasting water throughout your entire home. Our whole home filtration
systems are flexible, scalable and engineered to support the needs of growing families, busy
households and long-term home ownership.


### Healthier families, healthier homes

A Complete Home Filtration system helps reduce unwanted chemicals and contaminants. You’ll notice
the difference in drinking, cooking and showering, and many families say the improved taste
encourages them to drink more water.


### Protection at scale

Hard water minerals like calcium and limescale build up in pipes, appliances and fixtures over time.
Our ultra-fine filters with integrated softening help reduce this buildup, leaving fewer deposits,
cleaner shower screens and longer-lasting appliances.


### Relief for skin and hair

Chlorine and other disinfectants can be harsh on skin and hair, especially in hot showers. Whole
home filtration helps reduce chlorine exposure, giving your skin and hair a break from drying,
slow-rinsing chemicals. Thousands report softer hair and calmer skin.


### Better for your home and the environment

Whole home filtration delivers bottled-quality water straight from the tap, reducing reliance on
single-use plastics and harsh cleaning chemicals while helping lower your household’s environmental
footprint.

## Whole home water filtration Premium systems, better water from every tap

Australian water varies widely by location and water source. What works in one home may not work in
another. Complete Home Filtration systems are designed to adapt to those differences, delivering
consistently clean, great-tasting water throughout your entire home. Our whole home filtration
systems are flexible, scalable and engineered to support the needs of growing families, busy
households and long-term home ownership.


### Healthier families, healthier homes

A Complete Home Filtration system helps reduce unwanted chemicals and contaminants. You’ll notice
the difference in drinking, cooking and showering, and many families say the improved taste
encourages them to drink more water.


### Protection at scale

Hard water minerals like calcium and limescale build up in pipes, appliances and fixtures over time.
Our ultra-fine filters with integrated softening help reduce this buildup, leaving fewer deposits,
cleaner shower screens and longer-lasting appliances.


### Relief for skin and hair

Chlorine and other disinfectants can be harsh on skin and hair, especially in hot showers. Whole
home filtration helps reduce chlorine exposure, giving your skin and hair a break from drying,
slow-rinsing chemicals. Thousands report softer hair and calmer skin.


### Better for your home and the environment

Whole home filtration delivers bottled-quality water straight from the tap, reducing reliance on
single-use plastics and harsh cleaning chemicals while helping lower your household’s environmental
footprint.

Get to know our products

# Dafi Pitchers

Essential in Your kitchen

designed to obtain 40 to 50 gallons of tasty and healthy water. Ideal for drinking, boiling, and
cooking. [More][18]

# Alkaline UP Cartridge

designed to meet your dietary needs

Alkaline UP cartridges thanks to their unique and innovatory feature increases pH level and negative
ORP potential of tap water. [More][19]

# Dafi Bottle

Tasty and healthy water to take anywhere

Removes from tap water unpleasant taste and odor of chlorine. A removable filter replaces up to 300
17 oz. PET bottles. Designed for people who appreciate the role of regular hydration, play sports
and live a healthy lifestyle. [More][20]

# Standard Cartridge

Universal

Designed for softening of tap water without demineralization. Reduces potential impurities and
chlorine. [More][21]

# Vacuum containers

extended food storage

Designed to protect your food from loss of freshness and drying. Extend the expiration date by even
5 times.  Also help to keep your fridge odourless. [More][22]

# Dafi cartridges **provide many benefits**

BE GREEN
Reduces plastic bottle wastes and filters approx. 30-40 gal. of water per month.
HEALTH
Removes unwanted substances such as chlorine, heavy metals, pesticides, herbicides and organic
pollutants from the water
TASTE
Quenches your thirst, brews tea, coffee and prepares meals for the whole family.
COMFORT

The jug fits most refrigerator doors and it is dishwasher safe (without the lid).

HOUSEHOLD APPLIANCE PROTECTION
Softens the water and allows you to forget about the build up of scale inside the kettle, coffee
maker and iron.
SAVINGS
A litre of pure water costs 3 cents saving up to 300 USD annually.

# **Filtered water** is ideal for

Children's meals
Cold drinks
Tea and coffee
Cooking
Water bottles
Animal watering

# One Dafi filter **provides up to 200 litres of healthy water** per month

Dafi Pitcher Dafi Bottle
Check how much you can save with Dafi water filtration solutions!

# Dafi **Water Pitcher ** features

Easy filling lid
Tap water container
Filter space
Water container for filtered water
Filter exchange indicator
Ergonomic handle
Anti-slip pad on the base of the jug

# 5 levels of filtration **guarantees effectiveness**

Dafi filters remove:
* chlorine
* heavy metals
* pesticides
* herbicides
* organic impurities
The composition of the Standard filters is based
on raw materials such as:
**activated carbon**
which reduces chlorine
and organic compounds
**ion exchange resin,**
which removes heavy metals
and protects household appliances
from lime scale

# Innovative **AlkalineUP** Classic Cartridge

Dafi AlkalineUp filters enriches tap water
**with valuable magnesium.**
The composition of the AlkalineUp filters is based on raw materials such as:
* **alkaline deposit**
  which raises the pH
  of the water
* **activated carbon**
  which reduces chlorine
  and organic compounds



# Discover the possibilities of a** filtering bottle**

Ones a month replaceable filter removes from the tap water:
* unpleasant taste
  and smell of chlorine

**Leaves valuable minerals in the water
(including calcium and magnesium)**
The product is 100% recyclable, made of the highest quality raw materials
* reusable
* effectveness confirmed
  by the laboratory
* free of harmful Bisphenol A

## Meet Our New Pure XP Pitcher

Our most advanced filter yet. Engineered in our U.S.-owned facility and built to deliver unmatched
protection in every pour. Powered by patented CoreXchange™ technology, the Pure XP reduces today’s
most concerning tap water contaminants while cutting plastic waste by up to 75%. Cleaner water.
Greater confidence. Designed to help you Live Epic.

[ Get The New Pure XP Pitcher ][31]

## Why Choose Epic?

[Radical Transparency]

### Radical Transparency

We publish detailed testing results so you can see exactly how our filters perform. No vague claims.
No fine print. Just transparent filtration data backed by real independent verification.

[ Lab Results ][32]
[NSF Certified]

### NSF Certified

Epic goes the extra mile with independent NSF certifications, published lab results, and transparent
performance data. That’s how we help families confidently trust their tap water.

[ NSF Certifications ][33]
[Made in the USA]

### Made in the USA

Powered by patented CoreXchange™ technology and proudly manufactured in the USA, Epic supports
American jobs, American innovation, and American craftsmanship.

[ Filter Technology ][34]
[Sustainability & Impact]

### Sustainability & Impact

Cleaner water shouldn’t come at the planet’s expense. Epic helps reduce reliance on single-use
plastic bottles and offers a filter recycling program designed to give used filters a second life.

[ Recycling Program ][35]

## What’s In Your Water?

The quality of your water changes by location. In seconds, our ZIP-code water search shows you
what’s in your tap, and helps you choose the right filter for your home and lifestyle.

join a community dedicated to clean water and environmental impact. Better for you. Better for the

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is the most effective type of water filter? add

Reverse Osmosis (RO) systems remove the widest range of contaminants, including heavy metals, PFAS,
fluoride, and bacteria. For whole-house protection, catalytic carbon systems like SpringWell's CF
series are the gold standard. For budget-conscious buyers, advanced pitcher filters like Clearly
Filtered outperform traditional Brita/PUR pitchers significantly.

How often should I change my water filters? add

It depends on the system type. Pitcher filters: every 2-4 months. Under-sink carbon filters: every
6-12 months. RO membranes: every 2-3 years. Whole-house systems: sediment pre-filters every 6-9
months, main media every 5-10 years. Always follow the manufacturer's recommended schedule — filter
efficiency drops sharply past saturation points.

Does a water softener remove contaminants? add

No. Water softeners exchange hard minerals (calcium, magnesium) for sodium or potassium ions. They
do not remove lead, chlorine, PFAS, bacteria, or other health-related contaminants. If you have hard
water AND contamination concerns, you need both a water softener and a water filter — many companies
like SpringWell offer combo systems.

Are expensive water filters worth it? add

It depends on your water quality and goals. A $30 Brita pitcher removes chlorine taste but misses
most health contaminants. A $200 APEC RO system removes 1,000+ contaminants. A $1,000 SpringWell
whole-house system protects every faucet. We recommend testing your water first, then matching the
system to your specific contaminant concerns and budget.

How do I know what contaminants are in my water? add

Start with your utility's annual Consumer Confidence Report (CCR), available online or by request.
For deeper analysis, order a home water test kit from a certified lab like Tap Score or SimpleLab.
Well water users should test annually since there's no municipal treatment. Our [water testing
guide][73] walks you through the full process.

What are PFAS and should I be worried? add

PFAS (per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances) are synthetic "forever chemicals" found in 45% of U.S.
tap water. They're linked to cancer, thyroid disease, and immune system problems. The EPA set the
first enforceable limits in 2024 at 4 parts per trillion. If your water contains PFAS, reverse
osmosis and activated carbon systems are the most effective removal methods.

Do I need a whole-house filter or just a drinking water filter? add

countertop filter) is sufficient and more affordable. If you're concerned about chlorine/chloramine
exposure during showers, want to protect appliances from sediment, or have well water issues, a
whole-house system provides comprehensive protection at every tap.

# Drop in. Filter flawlessly. Cast with confidence.

Since 1984, our ceramic honeycomb filters have been the trusted choice for aerospace, investment
casting, and precision foundries—delivering higher yields, cleaner alloys, and fewer defects/part
without the hassle.

[ Request a Sample ][53]

##### Investment Casting Filters

## How We Elevate Your Casting Process

You’re under pressure: costly scrap, inclusion defects, and inconsistent results. Foam filters
require prep, introduce debris, and defect rates climb. It’s time for a filter that works for
you—not the other way around.

Stop battling inefficiencies.

[Holy Filter logo for Applied Ceramics’ molten metal and investment casting filters]

### Precision filtering that:
* **Requires zero cleaning**—drop it in and pour. No prep, no dust, no contamination.
* **Delivers laminar flow**, reducing turbulence-splash and inclusions while enhancing purity and
  strength.
* **Uses L3MM technology**, blending zirconia-level performance with mullite-level cost—delivering
  45% less scrap and 20% fewer re‑works, boosting throughput by 30%.
* **Withstands temperatures up to ~3200 °F,** engineered for the toughest foundry environments.
* **Offers customization and flexible inventory control**, tailored to your production needs—whether
  ramping up or scaling down.

### The Science Behind the Magic:
* Consistent flow rates ensure reliable solidification and mold fill.
* Oxidation, splash, and trapped air are minimized for cleaner, void-free castings.
* In demanding fields like aerospace, these filters reduce inspection failures, uphold tight
  tolerances, and maintain structural integrity.

#####  

## Honeycomb Vs. Foam Filters

Don’t See what you’re looking for? Talk to our Sales team to learn more about our custom sizes &
shapes available.

─────────────────┬──────────────────────┬────────────────────────────
                 │**Honeycomb**         │**Foam**                    
─────────────────┼──────────────────────┼────────────────────────────
**Prep/Cleaning**│Drop-in, no dust      │cleaning required, dust risk
─────────────────┼──────────────────────┼────────────────────────────
**Flow**         │Laminar, stable       │Turbulent, variable         
─────────────────┼──────────────────────┼────────────────────────────
**Defects**      │Fewer inclusions/voids│Higher risk of inclusions   
─────────────────┼──────────────────────┼────────────────────────────
**Consistency**  │Tight geometry/cpsi   │Variable pore structure     
─────────────────┴──────────────────────┴────────────────────────────

 

#####  

## Specifications & Customizations

We offer a range of standard sizes—and a capability to customize for your toughest applications:

───────────────────────────┬───────────┬───────────
**Typical Sizes**          │**Minimum**│**Maximum**
───────────────────────────┼───────────┼───────────
**Length or Diameter (in)**│.75        │6.50       
───────────────────────────┼───────────┼───────────
**Width (in)**             │.75        │6.50       
───────────────────────────┼───────────┼───────────
**Height (in)**            │.25        │12         
───────────────────────────┼───────────┼───────────
**CPSI**                   │4          │500        
───────────────────────────┴───────────┴───────────

 

## EXPERIENCE THE ADVANTAGES OF LAMINAR FLOW
* ### Enhanced Quality
  
  Our ceramic honeycomb filters induce laminar flow, ensuring superior removal of debris, slag, and
  inclusions from molten metal.
* ### Improved Flow Stability
  
  Enjoy stable and fast molten metal flow, preventing oxidation, splashing, and air ingress for
  higher-quality castings.
* ### Consistency
  
  Unlike foam filters, ceramic honeycomb filters offer consistent flow rates, minimizing variability
  and ensuring reliable solidification control during casting.
* ### Reduced Splashing
  
  Laminar flow minimizes the 'splash' effect, enhancing casting integrity and reducing void
  inclusions for superior final products.
* ### Enhanced Control
  
  Benefit from precise flow control and minimized flow variations, ensuring consistent casting
  quality from pour to pour.

[iStock-1149125684]

#####  

## Your Success, Cast Into Reality

With Applied Ceramic's molten metal filters, you'll:
* **Increase yield and cut scrap**, never wondering when costly defects will surface
* **Simplify your process**, no cleaning, no delays—just reliable filtration
* **Forge quality you can trust**, backed by decades of engineering, innovation, and performance

## Ready to See the Difference

Drop us a line to discuss how our filters can solve your process pain points.

## **Need Assistance?**

We're here to help! Our dedicated helpline is ready to answer your questions and provide solutions.

[   Request Consultation][120]  
[ Call us on 01352 838 281][121]

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

Browse our FAQ section for quick answers on all things water filtration.

+

### What does a water filter do?

A water filter removes impurities from your household water that you don't want in there. For e.g.
chlorine, fluoride and many others. You can choose between a drinking water or mains water filter.
One deals with just your drinking water and the other filters all the cold water coming into your
house.

+

### Why is Water so Important?

Water gives us the gift of life and even though it provides us with no calorific or nutritive value
is essential to our survival.

Water is a vital component of our diet and most of us don't drink nearly enough, so try to up your
water intake to at least 1.2 litres per day, which is around eight 150ml glasses. Tea, coffee and
alcohol dehydrate the body, so we need to drink more water to compensate.

Water transports oxygen, nutrients, minerals, dissolved salts and trace elements around our body. It
helps detoxify us by flushing out impurities. Water helps maintain our correct body temperature
which is generally accepted to range from 36.1C to 37.2C. It helps dispose of body waste. Water
alleviates constipation. It helps our kidneys function, which is why it's important to urinate or
empty the bladder regularly to avoid infections and other illnesses. Water cures dehydration, so if
you're feeling thirsty that's a good sign that you need to go and grab a glass of water. It helps
our endocrine glands function. Water helps the body convert food into energy. It supports every
organ in the body. You can't live without water. Well, you might survive for three to five days
before your body shuts down.

+

### Do I choose a Mains Water Filter or a Drinking Water Filter?

Buying a drinking water filter or mains water filter (sometimes called a tap water filter) can be a
challenge as there are so many domestic water filters on the market. The most significant question
you can ask yourself before you buy one of our water filter systems is what do you want to change
about your water? This is definitely the question we ask the most to anyone who contacts us.

If you're absolutely sure what you need then enjoy browsing around our online shop, using the
product search to find the exact water filter you want to purchase.

But, if you're unsure what you want to filter out of your mains or drinking water, that's where our
expertise and guidance come in. Either call us on **01352 838 281**, or [send us a message][122].

You're in safe hands with Fountain Filters.

We have a range of drinking water filters and mains water filters to suit an array of spaces, styles
and budgets.

+

### How can an under sink water filter help you?

There are a multitude of benefits to installing a drinking water filter or mains water filter in
your home.

Here's just a few of those benefits.
* **Filtered water 'on tap'**- We're always being told to ditch the carbonated drinks that are full
  of sugar and drink more water. When you're committed to drinking more water, you may as well have
  it 'on tap' so that you and your family can reap the benefits and enjoy filtered water all day
  every day without the hassle of having to run to the local shop to buy expensive bottled water.
  Trust us when we say that installing a drinking water filter is one of the most convenient and
  cost effective health and wellness investments you'll make.
* **Your food tastes better** - When you prepare fruit, vegetables, meat and fish that's been rinsed
  and cooked in filtered water you'll notice the difference in taste. Think about it for a second or
  two; if you can smell chlorine in your water, it's going to have an impact on that wonderful dish
  you're creating.
* **Scum; be gone!** - It's so annoying and unpleasant when you have a layer of scum floating on top
  of your tea. If you live in a hard water area you'll know what we mean. Good news is that you can
  filter the lime scale out of your water with a drinking water filter or mains water filter that's
  specifically designed for hard water.
* **Your skin, hair and weight will thank you** - If you don't drink enough water your body holds
  onto water causing fluid retention. Often when we feel hungry it can be a sign of thirst - so
  instead of reaching for food, drink water first and then see how better you feel.
* **You'll have more money** - A drinking water filter cartridge can last up to 12 months and this
  will cost you far less than buying expensive bottled water. We've had a quick look at some of the
  cheapest bottled water available and worked out how much it will cost you per day, week, month and
  year. Our figures are based on an individual drinking the recommended 2 litres of water per day.
  Remember, that there's often more than one person in a household so multiply the annual figure to
  get your true household figure.
* **Less waste** - The use of plastic is currently a very hot topic. Installing a drinking water
  filter or mains water filter means you'll generate less unnecessary plastic waste, which means
  less hassle for you and less plastic going into landfill.

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

Browse our FAQ section for quick answers on all things water filtration.

+

### What does a water filter do?

A water filter removes impurities from your household water that you don't want in there. For e.g.
chlorine, fluoride and many others. You can choose between a drinking water or mains water filter.
One deals with just your drinking water and the other filters all the cold water coming into your
house.

+

### Why is Water so Important?

Water gives us the gift of life and even though it provides us with no calorific or nutritive value
is essential to our survival.

Water is a vital component of our diet and most of us don't drink nearly enough, so try to up your
water intake to at least 1.2 litres per day, which is around eight 150ml glasses. Tea, coffee and
alcohol dehydrate the body, so we need to drink more water to compensate.

Water transports oxygen, nutrients, minerals, dissolved salts and trace elements around our body. It
helps detoxify us by flushing out impurities. Water helps maintain our correct body temperature
which is generally accepted to range from 36.1C to 37.2C. It helps dispose of body waste. Water
alleviates constipation. It helps our kidneys function, which is why it's important to urinate or
empty the bladder regularly to avoid infections and other illnesses. Water cures dehydration, so if
you're feeling thirsty that's a good sign that you need to go and grab a glass of water. It helps
our endocrine glands function. Water helps the body convert food into energy. It supports every
organ in the body. You can't live without water. Well, you might survive for three to five days
before your body shuts down.

+

### Do I choose a Mains Water Filter or a Drinking Water Filter?

Buying a drinking water filter or mains water filter (sometimes called a tap water filter) can be a
challenge as there are so many domestic water filters on the market. The most significant question
you can ask yourself before you buy one of our water filter systems is what do you want to change
about your water? This is definitely the question we ask the most to anyone who contacts us.

If you're absolutely sure what you need then enjoy browsing around our online shop, using the
product search to find the exact water filter you want to purchase.

But, if you're unsure what you want to filter out of your mains or drinking water, that's where our
expertise and guidance come in. Either call us on **01352 838 281**, or [send us a message][122].

You're in safe hands with Fountain Filters.

We have a range of drinking water filters and mains water filters to suit an array of spaces, styles
and budgets.

+

### How can an under sink water filter help you?

There are a multitude of benefits to installing a drinking water filter or mains water filter in
your home.

Here's just a few of those benefits.
* **Filtered water 'on tap'**- We're always being told to ditch the carbonated drinks that are full
  of sugar and drink more water. When you're committed to drinking more water, you may as well have
  it 'on tap' so that you and your family can reap the benefits and enjoy filtered water all day
  every day without the hassle of having to run to the local shop to buy expensive bottled water.
  Trust us when we say that installing a drinking water filter is one of the most convenient and
  cost effective health and wellness investments you'll make.
* **Your food tastes better** - When you prepare fruit, vegetables, meat and fish that's been rinsed
  and cooked in filtered water you'll notice the difference in taste. Think about it for a second or
  two; if you can smell chlorine in your water, it's going to have an impact on that wonderful dish
  you're creating.
* **Scum; be gone!** - It's so annoying and unpleasant when you have a layer of scum floating on top
  of your tea. If you live in a hard water area you'll know what we mean. Good news is that you can
  filter the lime scale out of your water with a drinking water filter or mains water filter that's
  specifically designed for hard water.
* **Your skin, hair and weight will thank you** - If you don't drink enough water your body holds
  onto water causing fluid retention. Often when we feel hungry it can be a sign of thirst - so
  instead of reaching for food, drink water first and then see how better you feel.
* **You'll have more money** - A drinking water filter cartridge can last up to 12 months and this
  will cost you far less than buying expensive bottled water. We've had a quick look at some of the
  cheapest bottled water available and worked out how much it will cost you per day, week, month and
  year. Our figures are based on an individual drinking the recommended 2 litres of water per day.
  Remember, that there's often more than one person in a household so multiply the annual figure to
  get your true household figure.
* **Less waste** - The use of plastic is currently a very hot topic. Installing a drinking water
  filter or mains water filter means you'll generate less unnecessary plastic waste, which means
  less hassle for you and less plastic going into landfill.

## What We Do

We're a globally recognized organization for public health standards. We conduct testing, auditing,
and certification, supported by accredited labs. Additionally, we provide top-tier consulting and
training for brands and businesses.
[Learn More About NSF][14]

## The NSF Commitment

The NSF certification mark is a pledge of assurance. It signifies our products consistently meet or
exceed standards, instilling confidence in quality and safety for consumers, retailers, and
regulators.
[Learn More About The NSF Mark][15]

## NSF Standards

Comprehensive assessment standards for public health and sustainability in the food and water
sectors.
[Learn More About NSF Standards][16]

## News and Events
* ### NSF Achieves European Accreditation for Drinking Water Product Certification Ahead of 2027 EU
  ### Deadline
  
  July 22, 2026
  The ISO/IEC 17065 accreditation from BELAC complements NSF’s testing capacity, enabling end-to-end
  support for EU Drinking Water Directive (DWD) readiness ahead of the January 2027 deadline.
  [Read the Story][20]
* ### NSF Awards World-First Community Catch Certification to Orkney Crab Fishery
  
  July 13, 2026
  Milestone certification sets a new benchmark for small-scale fishery sustainability and social
  responsibility.
  [Read the Story][21]
* ### NSF To Offer In-Person GMP and Regulatory Compliance Courses at SupplySide Global 2026
  
  July 13, 2026
  NSF is offering a comprehensive GMP and regulatory compliance training program of classroom-based
  courses for dietary supplement industry professionals at SupplySide Global 2026.
  [Read the Story][22]
* ### NSF Issues First-Ever MSC Certification for an Eel Fishery to Perupez S.A.C. and Sakana del
  ### Peru
  
  June 19, 2026
  Third-party certification plays a key role in independently verifying the sustainability of
  seafood operations.
  [Read the Story][23]

## Attach directly to any standard hose bib (garden hose faucet)

## **Why Choose Our Jug Filter?**
* **Cost-effective:** No more lugging around heavy 40-pound jugs or expensive bottled water.
* **Durability:** Filters hundreds of gallons of water (equivalent to dozens of five-gallon
  bottles).

**Note:  Filter should be replaced within six months or when flow rate slows.**
* **Convenience:** Lightweight and portable. Use it at home, while camping, or on the go. No more
  searching for water-filling stations.
* **Ease of Use:** Simple instructions are included with the product to ensure easy setup and
  operation.
* Clean, pristine water is now at your fingertips—anytime, anywhere!

## **FAQ's**

### Which EZ Jug filtration system will fit my faucet?

Our systems fit most hose bibs. Adapters are available online to connect the EZ Jug Filter to most
faucets having a removable aerator.  Pull-out and handheld faucets are not compatible with our
systems.

### How do I install a water filter for 5 gallon jug?

Installing your **water filter for 5 gallon jug** is quick and simple. Follow these steps or refer
to your owner’s manual:

**For use with a standard hose bib (outdoor faucet):**
1. Attach the EZ Jug™ filter directly to the tap
2. Run water through the filter for a few minutes to purge it
3. Connect the jug cap to your 5 gallon water bottle
4. Start filling with clean, filtered water

### Is the EZ Jug filtration system recyclable?

Unfortunately, the carbon filter is not recyclable.  We are in the process of building a recycling
program for our customers.  Please check this page in the future for updates. 

### How do I clean my EZ JUG System?

Wipe the outside of the **EZ Jug™ ** with a clean, damp, soft cloth. While a mild dishwashing liquid
may also be used, do NOT allow any detergent to enter the hose, filter, fittings or adapter.

To Clean the Jug Cap, unscrew the spout by turning counterclockwise.  Soak the cap and spout in a
solution of warm water and a mild detergent or a diluted vinegar solution before scrubbing with a
brush. Rinse and allow to thoroughly dry.

### How do I clean my water Jug.

Here are some ways to clean a 3-gallon or 5-gallon water jug:
* Bleach
  Fill the jug with tap water and add 1/2 teaspoon of bleach per 5 gallons of water. Let it sit for
  at least one minute, then wash the lid and spray the inside of the jug. Wipe it down with a clean,
  dry towel. If the water is cloudy, double the amount of bleach. Rinse well, and re-rinse. Allow to
  thoroughly dry.
* Vinegar
  Fill the jug halfway with warm water and equal parts white vinegar. Let it sit for about 15
  minutes, Rinse well, and re-rinse. Allow to thoroughly dry.

### How do I know when it is time to replace my faucet filter?

To ensure maximum efficiency, replace your system:
* Replace the filter 1000 gallon, or
* 6 months following the first use, or
* If you notice a change in taste or odor to your filtered water, or
* If you notice a reduction in water flow from the filter into the jug

### Can I run hot water through the filter?

Use cold water only. Do not use with water above 82°F/28°C as this may damage the filter. Do not use
with water that is microbiologically unsafe, or of unknown quality, without adequate disinfection
before or after the system. Individuals requiring water of a certain microbiological purity should
consult their physician.

### Is the EZ Jug filtration system patented?

The **EZ Jug™ ** has 3 international Patents Pending, Including in the the USA and China

## **Why Choose Our Jug Filter?**
* **Cost-effective:** No more lugging around heavy 40-pound jugs or expensive bottled water.
* **Durability:** Filters hundreds of gallons of water (equivalent to dozens of five-gallon
  bottles).

**Note:  Filter should be replaced within six months or when flow rate slows.**
* **Convenience:** Lightweight and portable. Use it at home, while camping, or on the go. No more
  searching for water-filling stations.
* **Ease of Use:** Simple instructions are included with the product to ensure easy setup and
  operation.
* Clean, pristine water is now at your fingertips—anytime, anywhere!

## **FAQ's**

### Which EZ Jug filtration system will fit my faucet?

Our systems fit most hose bibs. Adapters are available online to connect the EZ Jug Filter to most
faucets having a removable aerator.  Pull-out and handheld faucets are not compatible with our
systems.

### How do I install a water filter for 5 gallon jug?

Installing your **water filter for 5 gallon jug** is quick and simple. Follow these steps or refer
to your owner’s manual:

**For use with a standard hose bib (outdoor faucet):**
1. Attach the EZ Jug™ filter directly to the tap
2. Run water through the filter for a few minutes to purge it
3. Connect the jug cap to your 5 gallon water bottle
4. Start filling with clean, filtered water

### Is the EZ Jug filtration system recyclable?

Unfortunately, the carbon filter is not recyclable.  We are in the process of building a recycling
program for our customers.  Please check this page in the future for updates. 

### How do I clean my EZ JUG System?

Wipe the outside of the **EZ Jug™ ** with a clean, damp, soft cloth. While a mild dishwashing liquid
may also be used, do NOT allow any detergent to enter the hose, filter, fittings or adapter.

To Clean the Jug Cap, unscrew the spout by turning counterclockwise.  Soak the cap and spout in a
solution of warm water and a mild detergent or a diluted vinegar solution before scrubbing with a
brush. Rinse and allow to thoroughly dry.

### How do I clean my water Jug.

Here are some ways to clean a 3-gallon or 5-gallon water jug:
* Bleach
  Fill the jug with tap water and add 1/2 teaspoon of bleach per 5 gallons of water. Let it sit for
  at least one minute, then wash the lid and spray the inside of the jug. Wipe it down with a clean,
  dry towel. If the water is cloudy, double the amount of bleach. Rinse well, and re-rinse. Allow to
  thoroughly dry.
* Vinegar
  Fill the jug halfway with warm water and equal parts white vinegar. Let it sit for about 15
  minutes, Rinse well, and re-rinse. Allow to thoroughly dry.

### How do I know when it is time to replace my faucet filter?

To ensure maximum efficiency, replace your system:
* Replace the filter 1000 gallon, or
* 6 months following the first use, or
* If you notice a change in taste or odor to your filtered water, or
* If you notice a reduction in water flow from the filter into the jug

### Can I run hot water through the filter?

Use cold water only. Do not use with water above 82°F/28°C as this may damage the filter. Do not use
with water that is microbiologically unsafe, or of unknown quality, without adequate disinfection
before or after the system. Individuals requiring water of a certain microbiological purity should
consult their physician.

### Is the EZ Jug filtration system patented?

The **EZ Jug™ ** has 3 international Patents Pending, Including in the the USA and China

## **High‑Performance Gas Filtration with Lower CAPEX**

 

Pall’s High Flow Gas solution delivers reliable particulate removal for large‑volume gas streams
while helping operators lower upfront CAPEX. Smaller vessels and fewer elements reduce footprint and
maintenance demands while protecting downstream equipment and supporting long‑term performance.

 

[
Learn More High‑Performance Gas Filtration
][53]

## **Revolutionizing Filtration for the Food & Beverage Industry**

 

Membralox® GP-IC ceramic membrane systems deliver cleaner, more efficient processing with less waste
and downtime. Designed for demanding applications, they help manufacturers transform premium
ingredients and alternative protein production while reducing footprint and cost.

 

[
Learn More Membralox GP-IC
][54]

## **Supralon^{®} Replacement Oil Filter Elements**

 

With high efficiency and consistent performance, our Supralon Filter Elements enable customers to
rapidly achieve and maintain required cleanliness levels that protect lube and hydraulic systems
against component failure and unscheduled downtime that can cost tens of thousands of dollars per
hour.

 

[
Learn More Visit Supralon
][55]

### Passionate About Solving Your Toughest Challenges



Since 1946, Pall has pushed the limits of science and technology to tackle the most complex
filtration, separation, and purification challenges. From safeguarding health and critical assets to
improving quality and reducing waste, we collaborate with customers to turn the unsolvable into
solutions that drive progress.

## **High‑Performance Gas Filtration with Lower CAPEX**

 

Pall’s High Flow Gas solution delivers reliable particulate removal for large‑volume gas streams
while helping operators lower upfront CAPEX. Smaller vessels and fewer elements reduce footprint and
maintenance demands while protecting downstream equipment and supporting long‑term performance.

 

[
Learn More High‑Performance Gas Filtration
][53]

## **Revolutionizing Filtration for the Food & Beverage Industry**

 

Membralox® GP-IC ceramic membrane systems deliver cleaner, more efficient processing with less waste
and downtime. Designed for demanding applications, they help manufacturers transform premium
ingredients and alternative protein production while reducing footprint and cost.

 

[
Learn More Membralox GP-IC
][54]

## **Supralon^{®} Replacement Oil Filter Elements**

 

With high efficiency and consistent performance, our Supralon Filter Elements enable customers to
rapidly achieve and maintain required cleanliness levels that protect lube and hydraulic systems
against component failure and unscheduled downtime that can cost tens of thousands of dollars per
hour.

 

[
Learn More Visit Supralon

solutions that drive progress.

# Advanced
# ceramic
# filtration

The TAMI Group is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of ceramic tubular membranes for
crossflow filtration.

## Innovative ceramic tubular membranes

TAMI Industries S.A. develops and manufactures ceramic tubular membranes for crossflow, micro-,
ultra- and nanofiltration of liquid media. Primary application areas include filtration and
separation processes in the food and beverage industry, chemical process engineering, biotechnology
and water/wastewater treatment.

Many years of development experience, non-circular channel geometries, high-grade materials and
international patents make TAMI a strong partner for [filtration solutions][52].

### Many years
### of experience

For over 25 years, TAMI Industries S.A. has been one of the world’s leading experts in the
development and manufacture of high-performance ceramic membranes.

### Outstanding
### expertise

We provide advice on customised solutions for concentrating, separating, extracting and filtering
molecules in liquid media.

### Complete
### production line

From the membrane support to the separation-active layer – TAMI carries out the entire production
process in-house.

### Patented
### product diversity

Our application-specific ceramic membranes Inside Céram™, Isoflux™, Eternium™ and Filtanium™
demonstrate our innovative strength.

# Advanced
# ceramic
# filtration

The TAMI Group is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of ceramic tubular membranes for
crossflow filtration.

## Innovative ceramic tubular membranes

TAMI Industries S.A. develops and manufactures ceramic tubular membranes for crossflow, micro-,
ultra- and nanofiltration of liquid media. Primary application areas include filtration and
separation processes in the food and beverage industry, chemical process engineering, biotechnology
and water/wastewater treatment.

Many years of development experience, non-circular channel geometries, high-grade materials and
international patents make TAMI a strong partner for [filtration solutions][52].

### Many years
### of experience

For over 25 years, TAMI Industries S.A. has been one of the world’s leading experts in the
development and manufacture of high-performance ceramic membranes.

### Outstanding
### expertise

We provide advice on customised solutions for concentrating, separating, extracting and filtering
molecules in liquid media.

### Complete
### production line

From the membrane support to the separation-active layer – TAMI carries out the entire production
process in-house.

### Patented
### product diversity

Our application-specific ceramic membranes Inside Céram™, Isoflux™, Eternium™ and Filtanium™
demonstrate our innovative strength.

## **Revolutionising Each Drop with Cutting-Edge Water Filtration Technology**

It takes household water filters to keep drinking water pure. These little gadgets safely eliminate
contaminants by effective removal. With a variety of options, including reverse osmosis and
activated carbon filters, they offer specialised solutions to address particular issues with water
quality, improving health and lessening the impact on the environment by eliminating the need for
single-use plastic bottles.

With our Alkaline Water Filters, up your hydration game. These filters, which are derived from
superior Australian technology, add minerals to your water to give it a refreshing, alkaline
flavour. Accept the Australian approach of being energised and renewed with each drink.

[ [Woman pouring water from faucet into water filter jug at the kitchen] ][23]

#### [**Reverse Osmosis**][24]

Experience unmatched purity by utilising our Reverse Osmosis systems. These Australian-designed
filters are built to last, guaranteeing that your water is pure and satisfying your thirst without

with user convenience in mind, Our Water filters are easy to install and maintain, ensuring that

Embrace a sustainable lifestyle with our Water Household Filters. By reducing the need for

In what ways does a water filter enhance the flavour and purity of potable water?

By eliminating contaminants like sediment and chlorine, a water filter improves flavour and produces
a purer, more vibrant flavour. By removing impurities, it also guarantees drinking water of the
highest calibre, offering a dependable source for cooking and drinking.

Can I lower my home's risk of contracting a waterborne illness with a water filter?

Indeed, a water filter can help prevent infections that are spread through the water. Through
efficient elimination of bacteria, parasites, and other detrimental microbes, it guarantees that the
water you drink is safe to drink and devoid of potential health risks.

Which kinds of water filters are appropriate for purifying well water?

Minerals, germs, and silt are frequently found in well water. These problems can be effectively
resolved by water filters, such as UV purifiers, sediment filters, and activated carbon filters,
guaranteeing that the water in your well is clean and safe to drink.

### **Frequently asked questions**

In what ways does a water filter enhance the flavour and purity of potable water?

By eliminating contaminants like sediment and chlorine, a water filter improves flavour and produces
a purer, more vibrant flavour. By removing impurities, it also guarantees drinking water of the
highest calibre, offering a dependable source for cooking and drinking.

Can I lower my home's risk of contracting a waterborne illness with a water filter?

Indeed, a water filter can help prevent infections that are spread through the water. Through
efficient elimination of bacteria, parasites, and other detrimental microbes, it guarantees that the
water you drink is safe to drink and devoid of potential health risks.

Which kinds of water filters are appropriate for purifying well water?

Minerals, germs, and silt are frequently found in well water. These problems can be effectively
resolved by water filters, such as UV purifiers, sediment filters, and activated carbon filters,
guaranteeing that the water in your well is clean and safe to drink.

What role does a water filter play in maintaining a sustainable environment?

The need for single-use plastic bottles is decreased when one uses a water filter. This
environmentally friendly strategy reduces plastic waste and promotes a sustainable method of
obtaining clean, filtered water while having a smaller negative impact on the environment.

Can fluoride be taken out of tap water with a water filter?

Reverse osmosis and activated alumina are two cutting-edge water filtration techniques that are good
in lowering fluoride levels in tap water. These filters provide you much more control over the
particular contaminants—including fluoride—that you choose to get rid of.

How long does a normal water filter cartridge last?

A water filter cartridge’s lifespan varies based on usage and kind of filter. To ensure continuing
contamination removal and maintain optimal performance, it is generally advised to replace
cartridges every six months.

In what way does the performance of a water filtration system get enhanced by a pre-filter?

Before water enters the primary filter, a pre-filter serves as the first line of defence, catching
bigger particles like silt and trash. This keeps the main filter from clogging, extending its
lifespan, and guaranteeing steady water flow and effective purification.

Do water filters take away necessary minerals from water that is consumed?

The majority of water filters concentrate on eliminating dangerous impurities while keeping vital
minerals in place. Superior filters achieve equilibrium by supplying pure water without depriving it
of essential minerals, guaranteeing a balanced and healthful hydration experience.

Can lead be effectively removed from tap water using water filters?

It is true that heavy metal-specific water filters, like those that use reverse osmosis or activated
carbon, can successfully lower the lead content of tap water. For constant lead removal efficiency,
filter cartridges must be changed on a regular basis.

Is it possible to install a water filter system without the help of a professional?

A lot of water filter systems are made to be easily installed, even without the assistance of a
professional. The manufacturer provides detailed instructions that walk users through the
installation process, making it accessible to those who would rather do it themselves.

How can I determine whether my water filter is effectively filtering out impurities?

Make use of water testing kits that are readily accessible on the market to evaluate your water
filter’s effectiveness. With the use of these kits, you can detect any leftover impurities and
modify your filter system or change parts as necessary to keep improving the quality of your water.

Are there particular water filters that are advised for use with certain types of water, such as
well or tap water?

Indeed, there are specific water filters made to fit different types of water. While tap water
filters concentrate on eliminating chlorine and other urban pollutants, well water filters handle
special issues like bacteria and silt. The best possible purification is ensured by choosing the
appropriate filter for your water supply.
